assessment: This paper contributes to the growing body of literature that investigates foraging in complex sensory landscapes. It is therefore of interest to both neuroscientists and ecologists. Using behavioral analysis and computational modeling, the authors characterize different behavioral components of the foraging strategy adopted by the Drosophila larva as a function of food quality and food distribution. Altogether, this works sets the stage for investigating the genetic and neural-circuit bases underlying the control of foraging behavior.
